name: Goretusk Liver Pie

guaranteedRewards.name: Goretusk Liver Pie
tooltip: Use: Restores 58 health over 21 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 sec eating, you will become well fed and gain 3 Strength for 15 min. Additionally, experience gained from kills is increased by 5%.
classicTooltip: Use: Restores 58 health over 21 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 seconds eating you will become well fed and gain 4 Stamina and Spirit for 15 min.

guaranteedRewards.name: Recipe: Goretusk Liver Pie
tooltip: "Teaches you how to cook a Goretusk Liver Pie."
classicTooltip: Use: Teaches you how to cook a Goretusk Liver Pie.

narrative.details: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
narrative.objectives: Salma Saldean needs 8 Goretusk livers to make a Goretusk Liver Pie.
narrative.offerRewardText: These are just perfect, adventurer! Thank you so much. Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight. And here is a little something for you, for the hard work. You didn't think I was going to let a Champion like you go hungry, did you?
narrative.requestItemsText: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
